LanguageData.RL_JumpNoLanding: Cannot jump: the destination needs a clear, revealed, solid landing surface.
LanguageData.RL_JumpOutOfRange: Cannot jump: the destination is beyond jump range, including height difference.
LanguageData.RL_JumpBlocked: Cannot jump: a floor, roof or obstacle blocks the flight path.
LanguageData.RL_JumpClear: Clear jump path. Height difference counts toward jump range.
LanguageData.RL_JumpWaiting: Jump interrupted. No clear landing is available on this side of the obstruction. The pawn and carried contents are retained; clear the landing area to resume.
